# Vendored ffmpeg.wasm

Unmodified copies from npm, loaded only when a file needs converting (e.g. ALAC `.m4a` in Chromium).

| File | Package | License | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ffmpeg.js`, `814.ffmpeg.js` | `@ffmpeg/ffmpeg@0.12.10` | MIT | https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm |
| `ffmpeg-core.js`, `ffmpeg-core.wasm` | `@ffmpeg/core@0.12.6` | GPL-2.0-or-later | https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/v0.12.6 (built from FFmpeg, https://ffmpeg.org) |
